result.summary: The one limited rework of the design of REQ-069 (gate pass 3 findings N1-N7; decisions/0085 item 9) is done; only the design file changed. N1 (Medium): the range of chips is checked only when both ends of the question are valid integers, otherwise only the integer form of each item, and the question's own min/max line stands alone; D8, 5.6, F22, the 4.2 row, LK-5b and MU66 agree and D15 now lists how the shared ctx.int is called. Measured on a scratch copy of the sketch with the real check function: 504 combinations of min, max and chips against an independent model, 0 differences, no line with the word null, lineProblems empty; the rule of pass 3 gave 66 differences and 24 lines with null. Low items: N2 three false notes deleted; N3 'has its own desk' = the key is present, two-missing and wrong-value cases in LK-5a; N4 one case each for team size and chips count; N5 PK-8d in 13.4; N6 MU52 bound to SV-9a and SV-9b plus a positive assertion in SV-9b; N7 in D15. New mutants MU67-MU70 for the cases that no test saw (the series is now MU01-MU70); counts of tests, samples (87/89), messages (M01-M37) are unchanged. The design file has 853 lines, no code fences, no machine path, table rows keep their pipe counts.

finding_actions.action: D8, 5.6 chips, F22, the 4.2 checkChips row and D15 return to: the range of chips is checked only when BOTH ends of the question are valid integers; otherwise each item goes through ctx.int with no ends (the integer form) and the question's own min/max line stands alone. LK-5b rewritten: min absent / min = x with max 1000 and [-5,1001] -> exactly the question's own min line, no chips line; min 1 with max absent -> the own max line only; both ends x, y with [-5,99999,2.5] -> two own lines and one E_FIELD at chips[2]; min 1, max 1000 with [-5,1001] -> two E_LIMIT lines; lineProblems is applied to the lines of every case of the row (no line holds the word null). MU66 reworded (the one-ended range, or no range with both ends). Measured on a scratch copy of the sketch through the real check function: 504 combinations (min 7 values x max 6 x chips 12 lists) against an independent model: with the rule of pass 3, 66 differ and 24 lines hold the word null (lineProblems 'parser'); with the new rule 0 differ, 0 lines hold null, lineProblems finds nothing.

The three false notes about REQ-064 / the slip of decisions/0085 item 7 deleted (7.3, 15.2 item 8, 16.4). No other place says it (grep). The opening statement of item 6 of section 0 that REQ-064 is the stage storage is a true statement about the requirement and was left.

D7 and 5.6 (a)(b): 'has its own desk' = the key is present, whatever its value; the line is only at the first question without the key. LK-5a gets: two questions without desk (1,-,-,4 -> one line at questions[1]; 1,2,-,- -> one line at questions[2]) and the only desk of the file is a wrong value ('x' or null -> two lines: M24 at questions[0].desk and the integer rule at questions[1].desk). New mutants MU69 (line at the last question without desk) and MU70 (only a valid integer counts as present) bound to those cases.

LK-2f: five staff, the fifth with figure f13 -> exactly two lines (E_LIMIT at look.team, E_REF at look.team[4].figure); 5.3 team row says the items are still checked (LK-2f). LK-5b: five chips with one above max -> two lines (E_LIMIT at chips, E_LIMIT at chips[4]); five chips with a repeat -> E_LIMIT at chips and E_DUP at chips[4]; D8 and 5.6 say the items are still checked when the list is too long. New mutants MU67 (team items skipped when the size is wrong) and MU68 (chips items skipped when more than four).

13.4: new bullet - the PK-8d ban (call form of a skip, option form of a skip, the four letters of the word for an unwritten test inside any word, a path of this computer) applies to the three new test files; described, not written out (as with QS-12), AP-077.

MU52 now bound to SV-9a and SV-9b; SV-9b also asserts the positive side on the same tenants A and B as SV-9a: the answer of A holds A's own headline and staff name at look.team[0].name, the answer of B holds B's, on each language (so a look cached from a third tenant fails there too).

D15 states that ctx.int is not changed and is called by the new code only with both ends, a lower end only, or no end - as the released calls in validate.js and conditions.js (none passes an upper end alone); checkChips passes min and max only when both are integers.
